title: Unreal Engine 5.9 Kimodo Text-to-Motion: Test and Tutorial | Unreal News Episode 3
author: Evening-Crab4100
selftext:
Type a movement. Get a full-body animation on your PC with NVIDIA's Kimodo in the Unreal Engine 5.9 code.

  
What kinds of motion does it handle well, and where does it fall apart? Full breakdown on our YouTube channel.

  
\#UnrealEngine #GameDev #AIAnimation
